text:
alex: opened PR to add Bahamas (bhs-1) to the region matrix and to tighten residency wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/748
rina: Thanks — support asked for a brief FAQ line about embeddings retention and in-country storage. Can you paste the proposed line?
alex: Draft in PR: 
``
Bahamas (bhs-1): Supported. Dedicated and Private deployments: in-region embeddings storage available upon request (subject to contract). Hosted plans: embeddings may be stored outside the country for some tiers; contact support for residency options.
``
chris: Legal wants "available upon request" and to avoid operational specifics like "retention schedule" in public docs. Also prefer "data processing options" phrase.
legal-bot: Suggest final wording: "Data processing options available upon request for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted plans may store embeddings outside the country depending on tier; contact support for options (subject to contract)."
rina: We also need to update the Java SDK snippet in the migration guide — current example still uses us-east-1 and the old header name `X-Region-Old`. Proposed Java snippet: 
```
// Java (okhttp example)
OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient();
Request request = new Request.Builder()
  .url("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings")
  .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
  .addHeader("X-Redwood-Region", "bhs-1")
  .post(RequestBody.create(JSON, jsonBody))
  .build();
Response resp = client.newCall(request).execute();
```
alex: good. Also add migration note: "Clients using deprecated header `X-Region-Old` should migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` (deprecated 2025-01-15). See /docs/migrate-headers."
chris: Link-checker: /docs/migrate-headers currently redirects internally — point to /docs/migrate-region-headers to avoid CI noise.
docs-bot: CI checks queued for PR #748; link-check will report failures if URLs 404.
localization: i18n-needed: add EN + ES + FR for this page. We'll queue translations post-merge.
alex: thanks all — I'll update legal wording, change the migration link, swap the header in the Java snippet, and re-run CI. Planning to merge once green and translations label is applied. :thumbsup:
